algorithm.name: 固定通道归属与原树阶段归约
algorithm.method: Recognize exact tensor-port repeated homogeneous lane chains, unchanged binary scalar reduction, and scalar broadcast. Keep immutable-input lane ownership fixed, keep pure subtree ADDs local, gather mixed ADDs on a fixed collector. Emit original lane chains then pure then mixed ADDs. One direct candidate and one online E0; no historical oracle or parameter search.

offline_costs: No offline training or graph-specific evaluation precomputation. Development and pure mathematical proxy validation are separate from solver wall and invoke no E0; no new dependency or native compilation.

parameters.selection: one direct construction; no online comparison
